acceptanceCriteria: One original raw byte snapshot captured only after the existing same-Work-Item lifecycle lock is used for both first-direct classification and held-writer publication; ordinary finalization still validates its guard before observing input.

Deterministic TDD regression through the real public entry point demonstrates valid direct A replaced by independently prepare-valid ordinary PR B; old behavior must fail the A preservation assertion before production fix. A classification/write consistency defect is not claimed as a human-authorization bypass.

Invalid or malformed A cannot be replaced with valid B to publish; deletion or replacement after capture cannot alter captured A; duplicate keys, unknown fields, oversize and symlink/nonregular inputs reject without publication.

Preserve Contract, repository, runtime, work-item, merge-parent and base bindings; legacy obligation raw bytes, normal predecessor recovery 4 MiB boundary, idempotency and atomic publication. Existing tests and lock-before-observation assertions remain unchanged.

Limited declared diagnostic change: first no-predecessor read propagates existing bounded-reader path/type/symlink/oversize errors, while invalid typed or non-direct classification retains predecessor-required failure. Existing 8 MiB pinned-reader threshold is retained.

Use current-main helpers only, with a private cfg(test) deterministic one-shot seam; original 69-file candidate remains separate and byte-identical, and absent candidate features and B remain pending.

Fresh new-source validation and independent review retain actual test counts and all failed raw results; each declared command uses one worker and at most 900 seconds. No zero-test filter counts as evidence.

outOfScope: No candidate snapshot import; no external trusted authorization B
